pages.name: Menu
pages.description: How the menu looks: its size, its theme, its motion and its type.

help.purpose: Choose how GraceUI's menu is drawn, in game and in the browser alike.
steps: Set the menu's size with the slider; the menu redraws at once.
Pick Grace Clear for brighter text and thicker outlines.
Turn on Reduce motion or Plain text if fades or serif type bother you.

pages.name: Hotkeys
pages.description: The menu's key, and every mod's hotkeys with their conflicts.

help.purpose: See every hotkey GraceUI watches for, and which mod each belongs to.
steps: Choose the key that opens the menu: no Ctrl, Shift or Alt with it.
Look down the list: every mod's hotkeys, with their keys, pad chords and states.
Change a hotkey's key or pad chord on its row; a key another hotkey has is asked about first, then moved.
Reset puts a hotkey back to its mod's own keys, where they are free.

actions.label: Reset every hotkey
actions.confirm: Every mod's hotkeys go back to their own keys and pad chords, where they are free. The menu's key stays.

pages.name: Browser view
pages.description: The menu in a browser on this PC and on devices at home: its address, the browsers connected and the devices paired.

help.purpose: Open GraceUI's pages in a browser while the game runs: on this PC, and on devices at home once paired.
steps: Leave Browser view on, and open the address shown here in a browser on this PC.
Change the port only if another program holds it.
For a phone or another computer at home, turn on Other devices, then choose Pair a device in game and follow what it shows.
Forget a device to revoke it at once; Disconnect every browser to end every session.

actions.label: Disconnect every browser
actions.confirm: Every browser tab is disconnected and must load the page again.

sections.title: Other devices
sections.description: A phone or another computer at home opens the browser view once paired with a code shown in game, never in a browser. A paired device cannot change these settings, pair or forget devices, or set a mod's secrets.

row_actions.label: Forget
row_actions.confirm: The device is revoked at once and disconnected; it must be paired again to open the browser view.

pages.name: Installed mods
pages.description: Every mod connected to GraceUI this session, what each uses, and whether its notices show.

help.purpose: See which mods drew through GraceUI this session, and quiet one whose notices you do not want over the game.
steps: Find a mod by its name.
Turn its notices off to keep them here instead of over the game; GraceUI's own notices always show.
A mod that is not listed did not connect; its own log says why.

sections.title: Quiet notices
sections.description: What the mods with their notices off have said this session, newest first.

pages.name: Compatibility
pages.description: GraceUI's versions, its folder's check, and each mod's needs.

help.purpose: Check that GraceUI and the mods that use it agree on their versions.
steps: Look for a check that is not passed.
Read what it names: a file, a version, a mod.
Install the GraceUI the line names, or update the mod.

pages.name: About
pages.description: GraceUI's version, its licence, and the work it builds on.

help.purpose: See which GraceUI this is, and the open work it is made from.
steps: Read the version line.
Open the licence and the notices to see each library and font credited.
Quote the version when you report a problem.
